_assumptions: Bank, camera PCB and baseline are nominal geometry from supplied PDF; not measured physical parts.
Power bank recentered under the stereo pair to reduce the earlier right-side overhang.
The PDF omits ESP32-CAM-MB programmer boards. MB dimensions, header height, pin projection and USB envelopes are adjustable assumptions.
Camera carrier shoulders and ribbon geometry are simplified from photos. Verify contact footprints before fitting yokes.

Yoke hard stops give nominal zero-gap sensor-corner pad contact, without designed compression. Tune pad thickness only after checking the real carrier height; never force a printed key to push down the sensor.
MB width and height parameters are guarded against exceeding current nests. Larger MB boards require coordinated cage and keeper resizing.
Hardware models are simplified fit envelopes, not vendor-certified CAD. Electronics and pads in assembly are reference-only.
R03 uses printed T-pins and removable cross wedges instead of metal screws. Print fit coupon first.

R04 straight USB plug body envelope is an unmeasured conservative assumption: 24 mm projection, 16 mm width, 10 mm height; service relief adds 0.8 mm on each side. Actual plug fit must be tried before final assembly.
Cable route assumes a 6 mm diameter, 8 mm straight strain-relief length, 12 mm centreline bend radius and 16 mm exit. These are routing envelopes, not measured cable specifications.
USB insertion is checked over a continuous 20 mm linear approach along each socket axis. Socket engagement, hand access and actual cable stiffness remain physically unverified.
The R03 printed carrier in the supplied photos is replaced. Reuse of other R03 parts is checked separately against the R04 geometry.
